field: Master's and doctoral studies at host universities in Sub-Saharan Africa
qualifications: For graduates from Sub-Saharan Africa (In-Country and In-Region options)
Current calls cover programmes in Burkina Faso, Ethiopia, Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Tanzania and Uganda
Apply through the DAAD portal and separately to the host university for admission
Individual host-institution calls can have their own deadlines; the South Africa DAAD-NRF In-Country scholarship is paused
description_short: DAAD scholarships for Sub-Saharan African graduates to pursue master's or doctoral studies at host universities in their own country or region. Current calls cover programmes in Burkina Faso, Ethiopia, Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Tanzania and Uganda; applications close 12 November 2026.
